description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling vendor data in the vtiger CRM system, including validation, setting return values, and updating address fields in the parent window.

methods.name: check4null
methods.description: Validates that the product name field in a form is not empty.

methods.name: set_return_specific
methods.description: Sets vendor ID and name in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_address
methods.description: Updates address-related fields in the opener window's EditView form.
